info.name: Zemi Fleet V2
info.description:
Zemi Africa's rider-app API: order batching, 60 degree proximity matching and preference matching.

Run the folders in order against a freshly seeded stack (`docker compose --profile demo up --build`); every request has test scripts, and every saved example is a real response captured from the demo stack. Reseed between runs: the run uses up some of the demo data.

Set `base_url` and `api_key` in the environment (`Zemi_Fleet_V2.postman_environment.json`).
